name: Reparameterized Monte Carlo Volume Rendering
aliases: Reparameterized Stratified Monte Carlo (R/SMC) Volume Rendering
Reparameterized Stratified Monte Carlo Volume Rendering
definition: A differentiable volume rendering method that estimates expected radiance by sampling from the density-induced probability distribution using the reparameterization trick, allowing end-to-end gradient-based optimization without auxiliary models.
